service.name: Wedding music in Boulder
service.serviceType: Live music for weddings in Boulder: ceremony guitarist, cocktail hour duo, band and DJ
service.description: Live wedding music in Boulder and Boulder County: an acoustic, jazz or Spanish guitarist for a ceremony on a lawn or a porch, a jazz or acoustic duo for the cocktail hour at a volume the neighbours never hear, a trio or the DJ for the reception indoors under the venue's sound policy, on one contract with sound included and a short Front Range travel line.

faqs.q: Do you play weddings in Boulder?
faqs.a: Yes, the whole day or any one part of it, at the fee a Denver wedding sees plus one short travel line up from Denver and back, with no mileage arithmetic and no lodging. Every size arrives with sound, setup and pack-down, a certificate of insurance and a W-9. Signet Artists books Boulder weddings from Denver.

faqs.q: Can we have a band at Chautauqua?
faqs.a: Yes, at the size the site allows. Chautauqua sits inside a residential historic district, so its sound policy is the first thing to ask for, and a duo through dinner or a trio indoors in the Community House is what most weddings there book.

faqs.q: Is a trio enough for a Boulder wedding reception?
faqs.a: For most Boulder venues, yes, and it's often the biggest size the venue allows. A trio fills a floor without a stage, and the DJ takes the same sound system when the band is done. The Boulderado and the St Julien ballrooms take a quartet, and we'll say so when a date wants four pieces.

Parking is the Boulder question worth settling early: downtown is metered, Chautauqua shares its lot with a trailhead that fills on summer evenings, and a house on the Hill shares its curb with students during the university year. Tell us the address and we plan the carry. A solo needs about 6 by 4 feet and one dedicated circuit, a duo 8 by 6 and a trio 12 by 8, and setup is one van and 45 to 60 minutes.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we book wedding musicians in Boulder?
faqs.a: Boulder's short list of venues books its Saturdays a year or more out, and couples tend to book music after the venue and before most of the rest of the list. Tell us the date and the venue and we'll come back quickly, with the venue's sound rules checked.
